g.title: Carries the recorded Put and Get history out of the guest through the seedfall host module, which also carries sockets and properties. Nothing needs a forked runtime or rewritten source.
Picks the earliest fault, restart or wake-up at each step. What it did is recorded in the result as the trace.

After the run, Put and Get records are checked for linearizability with Porcupine against a sequential model. With the list-append model, an in-house Elle-style checker looks for isolation anomalies in sim.Txn histories.

The result holds the seed, fault list, trace and a hash over every host call. replay, shrink and verify all start from the seed, and run -check runs each seed twice and stops at the first host call that differs.
